statement_on_data_immutability: Raw data was inspected strictly in read-only mode and was NOT modified, overwritten, or cleaned in-place.
statement_on_model_training: CRITICAL: Zero machine learning models were trained, tuned, or executed in Phase 6.5. Feature matrix was audited strictly in read-only mode.

methodological_commitments.statement_on_arbitrary_thresholds: No arbitrary performance threshold is preregistered.
methodological_commitments.statement_on_top_decile_metrics: Top-decile lift and gain are evaluation metrics, not pass/fail thresholds. Top-decile lift and gain will be reported as business-ranking metrics and compared against the trivial and RFM heuristic baselines. No fixed minimum lift threshold will determine model acceptance.
methodological_commitments.statement_on_cohort_chronology: Cohort chronology is strictly respected. Genuinely chronological design trains on earlier period (Cohort 0) and evaluates forward on later period (Cohort 1), strictly rejecting backward future-to-past evaluation.
methodological_commitments.statement_on_cohort_overlap_and_independ: Cohort overlap has been measured (4,977 shared customers, 100.0% of Cohort 0, 94.24% of Cohort 1). Cohort 0 and Cohort 1 are rolling-origin cohorts and are NOT independent customer populations. No claim of customer-population independence is made.
methodological_commitments.statement_on_repeat_buyer_feature: No is_repeat_buyer_pre feature is added at this stage because it is a deterministic transformation of frequency_pre (frequency_pre >= 2). frequency_pre is kept as the primary feature. Any repeat-buyer indicator must be evaluated as an explicit ablation in Phase 7.
methodological_commitments.statement_on_model_training: CRITICAL: Zero machine learning models were trained, tuned, or executed in Phase 6.5. Feature matrix was audited strictly in read-only mode.

audited_pairs: Monetary is product of AOV and frequency. Highly skewed B2B orders increase correlation.
Frequent buyers necessarily purchase across multiple calendar months.
Total line items scales with order count and basket breadth.
Bulk wholesale buyers dominate both cumulative units and per-order units.
Rate normalizes count by total invoice volume; both are zero-inflated (57.6% zeros).
Lifespan is bounded by tenure; one-time buyers have lifespan=0 but positive tenure.
R_score_pre is an inverted 5-bin quantile discretization of recency_days_pre (|r|=0.946).
F_score_pre is a 5-tier discrete monotonic binning of frequency_pre (|r|=0.817).
M_score_pre is a 5-tier quantile binning of monetary_total_pre (|r|=0.655).

repeat_buyer_indicator_policy.policy: DO NOT ADD TO FEATURE MATRIX AT THIS STAGE.
repeat_buyer_indicator_policy.rationale: Because is_repeat_buyer_pre is an exact deterministic transformation of frequency_pre, adding it to the predictive matrix introduces artificial multicollinearity. frequency_pre already captures full order count granularity (F=1 vs F>=2 as well as higher orders). If a repeat-buyer binary indicator is investigated during Phase 7, it must be evaluated as an explicit ablation experiment rather than silently injected into the primary feature matrix.
repeat_buyer_indicator_policy.status: EXCLUDED FROM MATRIX; frequency_pre RETAINED AS PRIMARY FEATURE.

model_type_impact.logistic_regression: High impact. Multicollinearity inflates coefficient variance and destabilizes beta weights. L2/Ridge regularization or feature pruning is mandatory.
model_type_impact.random_forest: Low to moderate impact. Trees are robust to collinearity for overall predictive performance, but collinear features split importance and dilute Gini/permutation metrics.
model_type_impact.hist_gradient_boosting: Low impact. Tree-based boosting selects the best split feature greedily at each node, invariant to linear dependency.

missing_value_strategy.root_cause: Structural / Domain-specific: These 1,576 customers placed exactly one commercial order on or before T_obs (frequency_pre = 1). Consecutive intervals do not mathematically exist.
missing_value_strategy.behavioral_information: The missingness itself carries strong behavioral information (signals a one-time buyer with zero repurchase track record).

recommended_modeling_treatment.hist_gradient_boosting: Retain native NaN. HistGradientBoosting branches naturally on missingness without artificial numeric distortion.
recommended_modeling_treatment.random_forest: Median or cohort maximum tenure imputation. Note: is_repeat_buyer_pre indicator is NOT automatically added at this stage to prevent deterministic collinearity with frequency_pre; if tested in Phase 7, it must be evaluated as an explicit ablation.
recommended_modeling_treatment.logistic_regression: Median imputation. Note: is_repeat_buyer_pre indicator is NOT automatically added at this stage to prevent redundant collinearity with frequency_pre; if tested in Phase 7, it must be evaluated as an explicit ablation.

logistic_regression.transformation: log1p(x) transformation on highly skewed positive features (frequency_pre, monetary_total_pre, average_order_value_pre, total_items_pre, total_units_pre, unique_products_pre).
logistic_regression.categorical_encoding: One-Hot Encoding with drop='first' or top-K + 'Other' for primary_country_pre to avoid dummy trap.
logistic_regression.missing_handling: Median imputation on inter-purchase metrics. Note: is_repeat_buyer_pre is NOT automatically added (redundant deterministic transformation of frequency_pre).
logistic_regression.regularization: L2 (Ridge) or ElasticNet regularization to handle multicollinear pairs.

random_forest.transformation: Optional (tree splits are monotonic and invariant to log transforms).
random_forest.missing_handling: Median or sentinel imputation (-1.0 or max tenure). Note: is_repeat_buyer_pre is NOT automatically added.
random_forest.tree_parameters: Limit max_depth or min_samples_leaf to prevent overfitting on wholesale outliers.

hist_gradient_boosting.categorical_encoding: Native categorical feature support (categorical_features parameter) or One-Hot Encoding.
hist_gradient_boosting.missing_handling: Native NaN handling (zero imputation needed; preserves structural meaning of F=1).
hist_gradient_boosting.regularization: l2_regularization and early stopping on validation split.

primary_country_pre.recommended_encoding: Group all countries with <20 customers into 'Other', then apply One-Hot Encoding. Strictly avoid target encoding.

pre_cutoff_rfm_segment.rare_categories: None (smallest segment is At Risk with 205 customers, 3.88%)
pre_cutoff_rfm_segment.recommended_encoding: One-Hot Encoding (8 binary dummy features) or Ordinal Encoding based on RFM value tier.

frozen_evaluation_protocol.primary_ranking_metric: PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under Curve, average precision)
frozen_evaluation_protocol.justification_primary_metric: PR-AUC measures model discrimination directly on the minority positive class without being artificially inflated by high true-negative counts. It is the gold standard for e-commerce return prediction.
secondary_metrics: Calibration Assessment (Brier score decomposition and calibration curve slope/intercept)
Precision, Recall, F1 Score (at optimal decision threshold tuned strictly on training CV)
Top-Decile Lift (model precision in top 10% highest-risk customers / baseline prevalence)
Top-Decile Gain (percentage of total positive returners captured in top decile)
frozen_evaluation_protocol.top_decile_lift_and_gain_policy: Top-decile lift and gain will be reported as business-ranking metrics and compared against the trivial and RFM heuristic baselines. No fixed minimum lift threshold will determine model acceptance.
strict_prohibitions: Accuracy MUST NOT be used as the primary model-selection metric.
Test set outcomes MUST NOT be used to tune decision thresholds or select models.
All decision threshold tuning must occur on training cross-validation only.
No arbitrary performance threshold (such as fixed ROC-AUC or fixed lift cutoffs) is preregistered.

temporal_validation_specification.chronology_principle: Cohort chronology is strictly respected. The natural chronological experiment is to train/develop on the earlier period (Cohort 0, cutoff 2011-06-12) and evaluate forward on the later period (Cohort 1, cutoff 2011-09-10). Training on the future period (Cohort 1) and evaluating backward on the past (Cohort 0) is strictly rejected.
temporal_validation_specification.primary_phase_7_experiment: Preserves the 80/20 stratified split inside Cohort 1 for primary model development and benchmark evaluation (train=4,224, test=1,057; ~458 test positives; test_size=0.20, stratify=y, random_state=42), keeping the test set strictly untouched until final evaluation. Cohort 1 provides the deepest pre-cutoff history (648 days / 21.5 months).
temporal_validation_specification.temporal_robustness_experiment: Models trained on the earlier period (Cohort 0) will be evaluated forward onto Cohort 1 to assess model parameter stability and resistance to temporal concept drift across consecutive rolling quarters. Because 94.24% of customers overlap, this measures temporal robustness of behavioral features across rolling origins, not generalization to a detached independent customer population.

cohort_overlap_audit.population_independence_status: NOT INDEPENDENT. Cohort 0 and Cohort 1 represent rolling-origin observations of an overlapping customer base. Exactly 100.00% of Cohort 0 customers are present in Cohort 1, and 94.24% of Cohort 1 customers were active in Cohort 0. The 304 unique customers in Cohort 1 represent new customer acquisitions whose first purchase occurred between 2011-06-12 and 2011-09-10. No claim of customer-population independence is made.

benchmark_model_suite.description: Stratified random predictor drawing from empirical prior (p=0.4340).
Predict return=1 if recency_days_pre <= 60 days (or R_score_pre >= 4); else 0.
L2-regularized Logistic Regression with log1p transforms and StandardScaler.
Random Forest Classifier (n_estimators=200, max_depth tuned via CV).
Histogram-based Gradient Boosting with native NaN handling and early stopping.

model_acceptance_criteria.arbitrary_threshold_rejection: No arbitrary performance threshold is preregistered (e.g., arbitrary minimum ROC-AUC or fixed lift thresholds are strictly rejected). Model performance will be evaluated comparatively against trivial and heuristic baselines across multiple dimensions.
model_acceptance_criteria.top_decile_lift_gain_framework: Top-decile lift and gain will be reported as business-ranking metrics and compared against the trivial and RFM heuristic baselines. No fixed minimum lift threshold will determine model acceptance.
evaluation_criteria_matrix: Out-of-sample PR-AUC superiority over heuristic and random baselines (M0-M2).
Well-calibrated probabilities (low Brier score, smooth calibration curve).
Top-decile lift and gain reported as business-ranking metrics compared against trivial and RFM heuristic baselines (no fixed numerical acceptance threshold).
Minimal generalization gap between CV train and held-out test.
Temporal stability under chronological forward evaluation (Cohort 0 -> Cohort 1).
Model interpretability and feature importance sanity.
model_acceptance_criteria.decision_timing: Operational acceptance decision will be made strictly AFTER evaluating held-out test results in Phase 7.
